package.name: AIGenFurniture
package.description: A FreeCAD workbench for parametric furniture cabinet design. Generate base, wall, and tower cabinets from simple boxes, apply features (fronts, shelves, drawers), and export CSV bill of materials, cut lists and STL file.

workbench.name: AIGenFurniture Cabinet Workbench
workbench.description: Parametric cabinet generation workbench with CSV and STL manufacturing files exports.
